en.summary: Publish a static build to Pages
details: Publish static output built and checked locally or in CI with native Wrangler.
<build>: absolute output path; <name>: project name; <production>: project production branch; <preview>: a different branch name.
swcl prepares tools as needed. If authorization is missing, run swcl cloudflare/auth/setup. API Tokens need Cloudflare Pages edit access for the target account.
1. Check the account and select a project:
swcl cloudflare/wrangler whoami              #Check account and authorization
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages project list  #List available projects
To create a new Direct Upload project:
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages project create <name> --production-branch <production>  #Create an upload project

A Direct Upload project cannot switch directly to Git integration, so choose the publishing method before creating it. Git-integrated projects also accept Wrangler uploads, but a later automatic build can replace a manual deployment.
2. Upload the output:
Include static delivery files such as _headers and _redirects in the output directory.
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy "<build>" --project-name <name> --branch <preview>     #Publish a preview
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy "<build>" --project-name <name> --branch <production>  #Publish production
A --branch value matching the project production branch publishes to production; other branches publish previews.

Swaw Clouds runs Wrangler in a fixed temporary directory by default. To load project configuration or Pages Functions, add --cwd "<project>" with an absolute project path. Wrangler then reads configuration and environment files from that project.
3. Check the result:
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deployment list --project-name <name> --json  #Read deployment records
Check deployment ID, environment and URL, then request the home page, key assets and response headers. _headers applies to static assets; function code sets headers for Functions responses.
swcl help/en cloudflare/deploy/pages-git  #Read the Git build workflow
Project types: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/git-integration/
Native commands: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/commands/pages/
通过原生 Wrangler 发布本地或 CI 已构建并检查的静态产物。
<build>：产物绝对路径；<name>：项目名；<production>：项目生产分支；<preview>：与生产分支不同的分支名。
工具由 swcl 按需准备；尚未授权时运行 swcl cloudflare/auth/setup。使用 Token 时，需要目标账号的 Cloudflare Pages 编辑权限。
1. 核对账号并选择项目：
swcl cloudflare/wrangler whoami              #核对账号与授权
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages project list  #列出可用项目
需要新建 Direct Upload 项目时执行：
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages project create <name> --production-branch <production>  #创建上传项目
Direct Upload 项目不能直接改成 Git 集成项目，因此新建前先选好发布方式。Git 集成项目也可接收 Wrangler 上传，但后续自动构建可能覆盖手动发布。
2. 上传产物：
把 _headers、_redirects 等静态交付文件放在产物目录，一起上传。
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy "<build>" --project-name <name> --branch <preview>     #发布预览
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deploy "<build>" --project-name <name> --branch <production>  #发布生产版本
--branch 与项目生产分支一致时发布到生产环境，其他分支发布为预览。
Swaw Clouds 默认在固定临时目录运行 Wrangler。需要读取项目配置或 Pages Functions 时，增加 --cwd "<project>"，其中 <project> 为项目绝对路径。Wrangler 随后从该项目读取配置与环境文件。
3. 核对发布结果：
swcl cloudflare/wrangler pages deployment list --project-name <name> --json  #查看部署记录
核对部署 ID、环境和地址，再检查首页、关键资源与响应头。_headers 适用于静态资源，Functions 生成的响应头由函数代码设置。
swcl help/zh cloudflare/deploy/pages-git  #查看 Git 托管构建方案
项目类型：https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/git-integration/
原生命令：https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/wrangler/commands/pages/
